finite_gaps: iroh 1.3.0 and iroh-dns 1.3.0: pinned repository-root MIT and Apache-2.0 texts are bound through registry/raw-sources (see raw_materials and raw_source_binding); the iroh LICENSE-BSD3 remains component-scoped. No legal clearance or license election.

Current prepared-tree per-file equality remains unproven for libp2p-dns embedded header, libp2p-relay embedded header, libp2p-swarm embedded header, simple-dns LICENSE, iroh LICENSE-BSD3, noq-proto two license files, and noq two license files. Prior saved receipts for n0-future, n0-mainline, serde_bencode, and multibase show equal original/prepared hashes for the same archive digest, but do not attest current green-prepared bytes.

For most registry archive identities, reviewed receipts do not record an official acquisition URL. Locally verified archive hash equality does not establish source acquisition origin. URLs/revisions are stated only when recorded in cited receipts.

Historical crates.io requests for registry ironwood 0.2.1 and yggdrasil 0.3.1 returned 403 and are not the actual pinned path package identities. Pinned Ygg evidence here is specifically the Yggdrasil-ng revision/archive and shared root LICENSE.
This finite 17-path identity corpus is not a full root/nested dependency-license inventory, legal determination, artifact-inclusion proof, or distribution authorization.

identity_record_fields.cargo_identity: Exact lock path identity; source_kind/prepared_path disambiguate from any same-name/version registry artifact.
identity_record_fields.identity_rows_without_verbatim_license_t: Counts path identity rows with no retained verbatim license text at all; none remains after the pinned root bindings (iroh-dns@1.3.0 was the only such row).
identity_record_fields.identity_rows_with_component_text_only: A material-bearing identity with retained authentic component notice text but without complete package-level license terms; none remains after the pinned root bindings (iroh@1.3.0 was the only such row).
identity_record_fields.identity_rows_without_complete_package_l: Rows lacking retained complete package-level license terms, including component-only text and rows with no verbatim license text.
identity_record_fields.materials: Exact archive member and full byte size/hash. Embedded headers add half-open [start,end_exclusive) member slice and its hash. preserved_path is repository-relative and copied verbatim. A material may be component-scoped and does not by itself establish complete package-level license terms.
identity_record_fields.preparation_evidence: Receipt-recorded original/prepared file hashes or explicit unresolved status. Prior saved receipts do not certify current CI prepared-tree bytes.
identity_record_fields.receipt: Exact receipt path/size/hash; acquisition receipt is distinct from preparation receipt where both exist.
identity_record_fields.upstream_archive: Retained original archive path/size/hash and origin/revision only where a receipt records them; archive hash alone does not prove acquisition origin.

non_claims: No SPDX expression is used as verbatim text.
No registry package is conflated with same-name/version path identity.
